# ITEMS — the review list

*Generated by `build/gen_items_doc.js`. Do not edit — regenerate. Counts are measured at build
time over the **65,976** team-sheet entries in the clean corpus.*

**Mega stones are excluded** — 18,475 held items, 28% of the total, carrying one tag between them.
They were pure noise here; what they actually change is the *ability*, which lives in the MEGA
ABILITIES section of the master document. Dropped by the `megaStone` dex field, not by name.

That leaves **65** distinct items across **47,395** holders.

`untagged` is deliberate — it means the item genuinely has no mechanic worth modelling.

## What changed in this pass

**Sitrus Berry** — the tag named the *trigger* and not the amount. It fires at **1/2** HP and
restores **1/4**, which are two different numbers the kill calculation needs separately: a target
at 55% is not in range of what looks lethal.

**Life Orb** — recorded ×1.3 and not the **1/10 max HP it costs on every attack**, so the item
read as free. Its membership was also a name hardcode (`/^(lifeorb)$/`); both now come from the
handlers.

**Type-boost items** were a 24-name regex — `charcoal|blackglasses|mysticwater|…` — which
silently omits anything it forgot. Now derived from the handler, which names both the type and
the factor: **18 items** on sheets, each with its own type, all at ×1.2.

**Focus Sash and Sturdy** already shared `survivesFromFull`, item and ability under one tag —
that linkage was correct before this pass.

**Leftovers and Leech Seed** now share `perTurnHP`: +1/16 to the holder against −1/8 moved from
the target to the user. Leech Seed had only `statusCategory`, so its drain was recorded nowhere.

**Figy Berry** is on **0 sheets** and is correctly absent — the 0.5% floor doing its job.
